description.value:
Slot none; Price 5,000 gp (lesser), 10,000 gp (normal), 20,000 gp (greater)
Weight 5 lbs.; Feat Cost 1 sp

You can use 1 dose of contact, ingested, inhaled, or injury poison as an additional material component for a talent you cast. This talent gains the poison descriptor. Select a single creature affected by the talent. If that creature fails its saving throw against the talent, it must also attempt a saving throw against the poison used as a material component. If the target fails the save against the poison, the poison takes effect immediately, ignoring any onset time.

The poison uses its save DC (rather than the save DC of the talent), but is modified by any effects that increase the talent’s DC (such as Spell Focus). This effect works only with talents whose effects can be negated by a successful Fortitude save.

Construction Requirements
Craft Apparatus, Toxic Spell; Cost 2,500 gp (lesser), 5,000 gp (normal), 10,000 gp (greater)

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
description.instructions:
Selected profile: lesser tier; held slender rod. Apply as part of casting a qualifying sphere effect of caster level seven or lower. Hold this apparatus in at least one hand while applying it. Spend one of three daily uses; only one metamagic apparatus may apply per casting. Its feat's extra spell-point and casting-time costs are waived, but normal effect and other-metamagic costs still apply.

Provide and consume one actual dose of contact, ingested, inhaled or injury poison as an additional material component; no dose is bundled or automatically removed. Only talents negated by a successful Fortitude save qualify. Select one affected creature: after it fails the talent save, it saves separately against the poison's own DC, modified by effects increasing the talent DC. Poison onset is immediate only after failing that poison save; the talent gains the poison descriptor.

Shared metamagic apparatus rules. Feat Cost applies to taking the feat, not using the physical apparatus.
